## Source-support finding

**S1 — Decision scope acquires an unsupported planned duration.**

Draft: “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att testa en gemensam logg under åtta veckor.”

Complete proposition: In September 2025 the team decided that its shared-log trial would run for eight weeks. The source separately establishes the September decision and the trial's actual eight-week duration. All supplied material could be true if the original trial decision had no predetermined end date, or had a different planned duration and ultimately lasted eight weeks. Therefore the draft's attachment of “under åtta veckor” to what was decided adds decision content.

Smallest supported repair: “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att testa en gemensam logg. Försöket pågick i åtta veckor.” This preserves both supported facts without implying that the actual duration was decided in advance.

## Translation finding and quotation checks

**T1 — The literal building-as-agent formulation obscures the activity being started.**

Draft: “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa byggnad kommer i gång.”

Source: “I would set that time aside before the next building starts.”

The meaning and conditional stance are otherwise intact, but Swedish “byggnad kommer i gång” leaves a physical building as the entity starting up and does not idiomatically identify the trial activity. The supplied context settles the implicit referent: this is starting the trial in another building, not constructing or operating the building itself.

Smallest idiomatic repair: “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan försöket börjar i nästa byggnad.” This makes only the settled referent explicit and retains the speaker's conditional advice, first person and temporal relation.

The first quotation preserves the evening/morning contrast, completed prior work, customer ownership of categories, and Svale's assisting role. The second quotation's first sentence preserves the comparison between agreement work and first report entry, with no new absolute duration. The final quotation preserves Lind's affirmative conditional endorsement, practical shared-view benefit and extra-week reservation. Its “Det hjälper oss att ha en samlad vy” is idiomatic and equivalent to “Having one view … helps us.” No concrete meaning, certainty or voice obstruction was found in those passages.

The three quotations add, respectively, the specific shift handover purpose and ownership statement; firsthand preparation effort and advice; and Lind's own qualified overall assessment. The draft does not manufacture a universal supplier recommendation. Speech dashes are appropriate to the resolved Swedish convention; email interview attribution accurately signals the source medium.

## Completion status

Complete: every factual or attributed proposition in the full draft, including title, headings, framing and destination claim, has been accounted for. Two unresolved findings remain for the writer: source-support S1 and translation T1. No other source-support or translation findings. Sources and draft were not changed.
